page.overview:
What is Ghost Market?

Ghost Market is an upcoming Pixar feature film and is inspired by Asian myths regarding supernatural bazaars where the living and dead interact. It will be released in theaters on March 10, 2028 and will be Pixar's thirty-third feature film.

Hidden away in a remote location on Oahu's North Shore is 'Ono Market, a plate lunch shop that serves lost spirits, stuck between life and death. The living have never set foot in this place - until a food-loving, would-be content creator named Kyle blunders in, eats a mixed plate for the dead, and accidentally turns himself into a half-ghost. To get back to normal, he'll have to deal with paranormal deliveries, long hours in a haunted kitchen, and scariest of all… his own family.

The film was announced as Ono Ghost Market in a Wall Street Journal article on March 6, 2026. On March 20, 2026, a Wall Street reporter stated the film would be released on March 10, 2028. Later, it was reported that Trevor Jimenez would direct the film. According to Drew Taylor at The Wrap, Ghost Market was initially going to be a Disney+ follow-up series to Win or Lose but was changed to a feature film. Although unrelated to the series, many of the creatives involved with Win or Lose are involved in its development. At the 2026 D23 Expo in Anaheim, California, Pixar's Chief Creative Officer Pete Docter stated the film would be titled Ghost Market, dropping the Ono from the title.

Ghost Market, arriving in Spring 2028! 👻 -D23
